scope: Historical source code, registration, probes and acquisition helpers; registration is not proof of successful acquisition.

evidence_classes.registered: A historical adapter or source definition exists; no new live verification implied.
evidence_classes.probe_record: A dated historical probe result exists; this proves a probe, not a complete book.
evidence_classes.helper: A dedicated acquisition, resolution or cross-check helper exists.
evidence_classes.probe_code: Probe code exists; execution and successful acquisition are not established.
evidence_classes.reference_only: Mentioned as a fallback in code or documentation; no implemented acquisition established.

url_note: HTTPS homepages identify sources. They are not blanket assertions of current availability or automated access. See live verification separately.

stem.ia_query_method: mediatype:texts AND selected collection expression AND (subject:phrase OR title:phrase) AND format:DjVuTXT AND language:eng; exclude restricted/lending and inappropriate identifiers; item review remains separate.
selection_biases: Library subject indexing and collection membership
Download-count ranking in IA and citation-count ranking in OpenAlex are not quality proof
Historical plan excludes pocketbooks, tables, proceedings, catalogs and very short generic titles
OCR quality and exact edition identity need separate checks
workflow: verify hash, format, title, author, chapter order and completeness
stem.rate_policy: Use current official service limits, low bounded concurrency and bounded retries; respect 429/Retry-After. Historical jobs=2 is not permission to exceed current policy. Estimate request budget before large pages; operator credentials are local configuration.
stem.historical_evidence: Existing STEM candidate/picked/ingest artifacts and a private inventory snapshot establish that the route was exercised; no current complete-book inventory or success count is asserted here.
